candidate_reports.remark: The Tweeds Point RAWS site (QTWA3) recorded wind gusts in excess of 58 mph between 1533 and 1833 MST. The peak gust measured during this time was 62 mph_ which occurred at 1533 and 1633.
Trained spotter reported multiple landspouts southwest of Colorado City at 1705 on Saturday. Exact location estimated by radar.
Gusts at or above 58 mph started at 1103 and occurred intermittently through 1531. Peak gust was 68 mph at 1239.
At 1451 MST_ the KIGM ASOS measured a non-thunderstorm wind gust of 59 mph.
The QTWA3 RAWS recorded gusts in excess of 58 mph from 1633 MST to 2033 MST. The peak gust observed during this time was 62 mph and occurred at 1633 MST.
Five Mile sensor observed gusts at or above 58 mph from 1826 on June 26th through 2026 on June 27th. FMRC1.
Tweeds Point sensor observed gusts at or above 58 mph from 1633 to 1733. Peak gust 61 mph at 1733. QTWA3.
Five Mile sensor measured wind gusts at or above 58 mph from 2326 on June 27th through 0226 on June 28th. Peak gust 59 mph at 0226. FMRC1.
